item: slow members: leads-quality reads Home's fresh feed, bulletin-weekly leaves cards out (row 18)
summary: In the all-diagnostics bundle, leads-quality.json reads Home's cached feed when Home would serve it as fresh (else the bounded producer pass as before) and bulletin-weekly.json leaves its cards section unbuilt (card-audit already runs every producer). Each file says so in plain words and the manifest entry repeats it as bundle_note; the routes on their own still serve the full reports. 200k-article generated corpus: leads-quality 86 s to 0.01 s with a fresh feed, bulletin-weekly 107 s to 29 s.
